0022600215.text: The Orlando Magic (2-7, 2-3 on the road, on a four-game losing streak) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-9, 0-5 at home, on a three-game losing streak) for Orlando's 10th game of the 2026-27 season, with the Magic 12th in the East and the Kings 14th in the West. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), while Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Domantas Sabonis (knee soreness) and Keegan Murray (wrist soreness) are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Magic won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 121-117 in Orlando on March 26, 2026.
